questions.q: ______ the bad weather, the delivery arrived on time.
questions.exp: 後面是名詞片語 the bad weather，意思是「儘管天氣不好」，用介系詞 Despite。Although、Even though、Because 是連接詞，後面要接子句。

questions.q: The seminar was postponed ______ the main speaker was ill.
questions.exp: 後面是子句 the main speaker was ill，要連接詞 because。because of、due to、despite 是介系詞，後面接名詞。

questions.q: Please keep your phone on silent ______ the board meeting.
questions.exp: 後面是名詞片語 the board meeting，用介系詞 during。while、when、although 後面要接子句。

questions.q: ______ Ms. Wu was on vacation, her assistant answered her emails.
questions.exp: 後面是子句 Ms. Wu was on vacation，意思是「她休假的那段期間」，用連接詞 While。During、Despite、Because of 是介系詞。

questions.q: The printer is quite old; ______, it still works perfectly.
questions.exp: 舊、卻還很好用，前後相反，用 nevertheless（儘管如此）。therefore 是因果，moreover 是同方向再加一點，otherwise 是「不然」。

questions.q: We will not refund the ticket ______ you cancel at least 48 hours in advance.
questions.exp: 「除非至少提前 48 小時取消，否則不退票」用 unless（＝if…not）。so、whereas 意思接不上；despite 後面要接名詞。

questions.q: The new laptop is not only lighter ______ more powerful than the old model.
questions.exp: not only 配 but also：不只比較輕，效能也更強。

questions.q: It was ______ a busy week that nobody had time for lunch.
questions.exp: 後面是名詞片語 a busy week，用 such…that。so 接形容詞，不放在 a 前面；too、very 不接 that 子句說結果。

questions.q: Please call me ______ you arrive at the station.
questions.exp: 後面是子句 you arrive，「一到車站就打給我」，用連接詞 as soon as；講未來，子句用現在式。其他三個是介系詞。

opts: The flight was delayed, so we missed the meeting.
The flight was delayed, therefore we missed the meeting.
Because the flight was delayed, so we missed the meeting.
The flight was delayed, we missed the meeting.
questions.exp: The flight was delayed, so we missed the meeting. 用連接詞 so 接兩個句子，正確。therefore 是副詞，只用逗號接是逗號接句；Because…, so… 用了兩個連接詞；兩個句子之間只有逗號也是逗號接句。
